## Partitioning into two datasets

Conducting exploratory factor analysis (EFA) and exploratory structural equation modeling (ESEM) on the first half of the dataset, then conducting confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) on the second half of the dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

data_clean <- read_csv("../data/clean/caffeine_sensitivity_english_clean.csv")

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
    filter(if_all(caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12, ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12,
      ~ ordered(.x, levels = 1:5)
    )
  )

set.seed(123)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  slice_sample(prop = 1)

efa_data <- data_clean %>%
  slice(1:floor(n()/2))

cfa_data <- data_clean %>%
  slice((floor(n()/2) + 1):n())

nrow(efa_data)
nrow(cfa_data)
```

## Checking the prerequisities for EFA analysis

### Distribution of each item

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

efa_distribution <- efa_data %>%
  select(caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

# Changing to long-format
efa_long <- efa_distribution %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value")

ggplot(efa_long, aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "#595959", color = "#404040", alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~Variable, ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 400)) +
  theme_grey() + 
  labs(
    title = "Distribution summary",
    x = "Value",
    y = "Frequency"
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(), 
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0), 
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white")
  )
```

The plots show a right-skewed distribution. Items 11, 12 and 5 show a floor effect particularly.

### KMO and Bartlett tests

```{r}
library(psych)
library(MVN)

efa_items <- efa_data %>%
  select(caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12)

KMO(efa_items)
cortest.bartlett(
  cor(efa_items, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
  n = nrow(efa_items)
)
```

The results of KMO suggest that the dataset is adequate for EFA. Bartlett's test also suggests that the correlation matrix significantly differs from the identity matrix.

## Scree plot and eigenvalue

```{r}
poly_cor <- psych::polychoric(efa_items)$rho
eigenvalues <- eigen(poly_cor)$values
eigenvalues

fa.parallel(
  poly_cor,
  n.obs = nrow(efa_items),
  fa = "fa"
)
```

Based on the scree plot and eigenvalue, it suggests a two-factor model.

## Factor loadings in a two factor model

```{r}
poly_cor <- polychoric(efa_items)$rho

efa2 <- fa(
  poly_cor,
  nfactors = 2,
  rotate = "oblimin",
  fm = "minres",
  n.obs = nrow(efa_items)
)

print(efa2$loadings, sort = TRUE)
```

Based on the factor loadings table, items 3, 6, 9, 10 show cross-loading that suggests that a simple two-factor model does not show a clear structure.

## Factor loadings in one factor model

```{r}
efa1 <- fa(
  poly_cor,
  nfactors = 1,
  rotate = "none",
  fm = "minres",
  n.obs = nrow(efa_items)
)

print(efa1$loadings, sort = TRUE)
```

The factor loadings for all items are adequate.

## ESEM models

### One-factor ESEM

```{r}
library(lavaan)

model_1ESEM <- '
  efa("efa1")*factor1 =~
    caff_intox_revised_1 +
    caff_intox_revised_2 +
    caff_intox_revised_3 +
    caff_intox_revised_4 +
    caff_intox_revised_5 +
    caff_intox_revised_6 +
    caff_intox_revised_7 +
    caff_intox_revised_8 +
    caff_intox_revised_9 +
    caff_intox_revised_10 +
    caff_intox_revised_11 +
    caff_intox_revised_12
'

fit_1ESEM <- cfa(
  model_1ESEM,
  data = efa_items,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = names(efa_items),
  rotation = "oblimin"
)

fitMeasures(
  fit_1ESEM,
  c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")
)

standardizedSolution(fit_1ESEM)

```

### First-order ESEM
```{r}

model_2ESEM <- '
  efa("efa1")*F1 +
  efa("efa1")*F2 =~
    caff_intox_revised_1 +

'

fit_2ESEM <- cfa(

```
### Bifactor ESEM
```{r}
model_3ESEM <- '
  G =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_11 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  efa("S")*S1 +
  efa("S")*S2 =~
       caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_11 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  G ~~ 0*S1
  G ~~ 0*S2

  S1 ~~ 0*S2
'
  
fit_3ESEM <- cfa(
  model_3ESEM,
  data = efa_items,
  ordered = names(efa_items),
  estimator = "WLSMV"
)

fitMeasures(
  fit_3ESEM,
  c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr")
)

standardizedSolution(fit_3ESEM)
```
## CFA
### One-factor CFA
```{r}
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)

model_one_factor <- 'factor1 =~ 
caff_intox_revised_1 + 
caff_intox_revised_2 + 
caff_intox_revised_3 +
caff_intox_revised_4 + 
caff_intox_revised_5 + 
caff_intox_revised_6 + 
caff_intox_revised_7 +
caff_intox_revised_8 + 
caff_intox_revised_9 + 
caff_intox_revised_10 +
caff_intox_revised_11 + 
caff_intox_revised_12'

fit_one_factor <- cfa(model_one_factor,
  data= cfa_data,
  estimator= "WLSMV",
  ordered= c("caff_intox_revised_1", 
             "caff_intox_revised_2", 
             "caff_intox_revised_3", 
             "caff_intox_revised_4",
             "caff_intox_revised_5", 
             "caff_intox_revised_6", 
             "caff_intox_revised_7", 
             "caff_intox_revised_8",
             "caff_intox_revised_9", 
             "caff_intox_revised_10", 
             "caff_intox_revised_11", 
             "caff_intox_revised_12")
  )

fitMeasures(fit_one_factor, c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr"))
reliability(fit_one_factor)
```

## Bifactor
```{r}
library(lavaan)

model_bifactor_ESEM <- '
  efa("bi")*G  =~ caff_intox_revised_1 + caff_intox_revised_2 + caff_intox_revised_3 +
                  caff_intox_revised_4 + caff_intox_revised_5 + caff_intox_revised_6 +
                  caff_intox_revised_7 + caff_intox_revised_8 + caff_intox_revised_9 +
                  caff_intox_revised_10 + caff_intox_revised_11 + caff_intox_revised_12

  efa("bi")*S1 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 + caff_intox_revised_2 + caff_intox_revised_3 +
                  caff_intox_revised_4 + caff_intox_revised_5 + caff_intox_revised_6 +
                  caff_intox_revised_7 + caff_intox_revised_8 + caff_intox_revised_9 +
                  caff_intox_revised_10 + caff_intox_revised_11 + caff_intox_revised_12

  efa("bi")*S2 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 + caff_intox_revised_2 + caff_intox_revised_3 +
                  caff_intox_revised_4 + caff_intox_revised_5 + caff_intox_revised_6 +
                  caff_intox_revised_7 + caff_intox_revised_8 + caff_intox_revised_9 +
                  caff_intox_revised_10 + caff_intox_revised_11 + caff_intox_revised_12
                  
  G  ~~ 0*S1 + 0*S2
  S1 ~~ 0*S2
'

fit_bifactor_ESEM <- cfa(
  model_bifactor_ESEM,
  data = efa_items,
  ordered = names(efa_items),
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  rotation = "bigeomin"
)

fitMeasures(fit_bifactor_ESEM, c("cfi.robust", "tli.robust", "rmsea.robust", "srmr"))
standardizedSolution(fit_bifactor_ESEM)
```
## Bifactor
```{r}
bifactor_model <- '

  G =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_11 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  F1 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
        caff_intox_revised_2 +
        caff_intox_revised_3 +
        caff_intox_revised_4 +
        caff_intox_revised_10

  F2 =~ caff_intox_revised_5 +
        caff_intox_revised_6 +
        caff_intox_revised_7 +
        caff_intox_revised_8 +
        caff_intox_revised_9 +
        caff_intox_revised_11 +
        caff_intox_revised_12

  G ~~ 0*F1
  G ~~ 0*F2
  F1 ~~ 0*F2
'

fit_bifactor <- cfa(
  bifactor_model,
  data = cfa_data,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = c(
    "caff_intox_revised_1",
    "caff_intox_revised_2",
    "caff_intox_revised_3",
    "caff_intox_revised_4",
    "caff_intox_revised_5",
    "caff_intox_revised_6",
    "caff_intox_revised_7",
    "caff_intox_revised_8",
    "caff_intox_revised_9",
    "caff_intox_revised_10",
    "caff_intox_revised_11",
    "caff_intox_revised_12"
  )
)

summary(
  fit_bifactor,
  fit.measures = TRUE,
  standardized = TRUE
)


```

## CFA - Bifactor modell
```{r}
bifactor_model <- '

  G =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
       caff_intox_revised_2 +
       caff_intox_revised_3 +
       caff_intox_revised_4 +
       caff_intox_revised_5 +
       caff_intox_revised_6 +
       caff_intox_revised_7 +
       caff_intox_revised_8 +
       caff_intox_revised_9 +
       caff_intox_revised_10 +
       caff_intox_revised_11 +
       caff_intox_revised_12

  F1 =~ caff_intox_revised_1 +
        caff_intox_revised_2 +
        caff_intox_revised_3 +
        caff_intox_revised_4 +
        caff_intox_revised_10

  F2 =~ caff_intox_revised_5 +
        caff_intox_revised_6 +
        caff_intox_revised_7 +
        caff_intox_revised_8 +
        caff_intox_revised_9 +
        caff_intox_revised_11 +
        caff_intox_revised_12

  G ~~ 0*F1
  G ~~ 0*F2
  F1 ~~ 0*F2
'

fit_bifactor <- cfa(
  bifactor_model,
  data = data_clean,
  estimator = "WLSMV",
  ordered = TRUE,
  std.lv = TRUE

  standardized = TRUE
```
